en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who restrains his anger from the people, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Restrain the Punishment from him on the Day of Judgment’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever controls his anger against people, consequently, Allah will, on the Day of Judgment, hold back the fire from him.”
